title: Slimes Reborn
description: A pack that aims to overhaul anything slime-related!
body:
# Slimes Reborn
____________________________________________

![EMF & ETF OR Optfine is required to run this pack properly!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38d077ff850259e98b27dac25d5080f960237a89_0.webp)

Slimes Reborn is a resource pack that overhauls the following:

## Entities

Small Slime, Medium Slime, Large Slime

## Items

-Slime Ball

## Blocks

Slime Block, Sticky Piston
____________________________________________

! TEXTURES ARE BOUND TO CHANGE IN LATER VERSIONS OF THIS RESOURCE PACK. THIS IS AN EXPERIMENTAL RESOURCE PACK THAT I PLAN TO UPDATE SOON AFTER RELEASE.

Also modded support is planned for the future, so stay tuned!
